name: Energy Capital Partners
rationale: Co-lead (with KKR) on the ~$7.7bn (£5.75bn) agreed take-private of DCC Energy plc (LSE:DCC, FTSE 100 LPG/fuel-oil energy distributor), announced 2026-07-27 - KKR's largest European public-to-private in over a decade. Not logged as an event row this week: the target is traditional energy distribution (LPG, heating oil), not power generation/datacenter-adjacent infrastructure, so it falls outside this class's AI-buildout thesis (see summary.md). ECP is a specialist energy-transition-infrastructure manager (also holds Grain LNG in the UK) and is not yet on the watchlist; flagging since it paired with a tracked name on a large energy platform deal and could recur.
